pages: happy birthday!! i wanted to give you something that can't be unwrapped in a minute, so i wrote this instead. read it slowly, okay?
another year has passed, and somehow every single one makes me luckier than the last.
i think about the small things the most: the way you hum while you cook, the way you laugh before the end of your own joke, the way you make a quiet room feel like home.
thank you for being patient with me, and for being brave on the days i wasn't.
this year, i wish you slow mornings, loud laughter, and every dream you've been too shy to say out loud.
whatever comes next, i'm right here, and i'm so proud to be yours.
